description: This source file contains definitions of Orleans grains with dependency injection, including classes for grains, services, and service implementations, along with their methods and logic for managing dependencies in a distributed actor model.

classes.name: DIGrainWithInjectedServices
classes.description: A grain class that demonstrates dependency injection of various services and context management within Orleans.

classes.name: ExplicitlyRegisteredSimpleDIGrain
classes.description: A simple grain class illustrating registration and use of injected services and values.

classes.name: InjectedService
classes.description: An implementation of IInjectedService that provides timestamp and instance value, manages disposal.

classes.name: InjectedScopedService
classes.description: An implementation of IInjectedScopedService that provides a per-scoped instance value, manages disposal.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation logic for the grain, storing original grain context.

methods.name: GetLongValue
methods.description: Returns a timestamp as a long value from the injected service.

methods.name: GetStringValue
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the grain ID from the grain context.

methods.name: GetInjectedSingletonServiceValue
methods.description: Returns the value from the injected singleton service.

methods.name: GetInjectedScopedServiceValue
methods.description: Returns the value from the injected scoped service.

methods.name: GetGrainFactoryId
methods.description: Returns the hash code identifier of the injected grain factory.

methods.name: DoDeactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain by calling DeactivateOnIdle.

methods.name: AssertCanResolveSameServiceInstances
methods.description: Verifies that the registered services resolve to the same instances as injected.

methods.name: GetLongValue (ExplicitlyRegisteredSimpleDIGrain)
methods.description: Returns a long value indicating the number of released instances before activation.

methods.name: GetStringValue (ExplicitlyRegisteredSimpleDIGrain)
methods.description: Returns a string value that was injected during construction.

methods.name: GetInstanceValue
methods.description: Returns the unique instance value (GUID string).
